title: nf-core/exogap pipeline - input.csv schema
description: Schema for the file provided with input.csv

name.description: Unique genome name used throughout the pipeline.
name.errorMessage: Genome name must contain only letters, numbers, spaces, dots (.), underscores (_) and hyphens (-).

taxid.description: NCBI Taxonomy identifier of the species.

fasta.description: Path to the genome assembly FASTA file.
fasta.errorMessage: FASTA must be the path to an existing genome assembly file.

RNASeq-dir.description: Optional directory containing RNA-seq FASTQ files.
RNASeq-dir.errorMessage: RNASeq-dir must be the path to an existing directory when provided.

SRA.description: Optional SRA accession(s), separated by ';' if multiple.
SRA.errorMessage: SRA must be empty or contain one or more valid SRA accessions (SRR, ERR or DRR), separated by ';'.

repeats_set.description: Optional repeat library in FASTA format.
repeats_set.errorMessage: repeats_set must be the path to an existing FASTA file (.fa, .fna or .fasta).

mnemonic.description: Optional short species identifier used in comparative analyses.
mnemonic.errorMessage: Mnemonic must contain only letters and numbers, with no spaces or special characters.

translation_table.description: Nuclear genetic code for this genome, overriding the global default.

locus_tag_prefix.description: Registered locus-tag prefix for this genome.
